name: multi_tf (BTC/ETH-relative RSI cascade dip buy)
author: freqtrade-strategies
indicators: RSI(14) on pair at 5m/30m/1h; BTC/stake RSI 1h, RSI(4) and RSI(2) 1h; ETH/BTC RSI 1h
entry_long: BTC RSI1h<35 AND ETH/BTC RSI1h<50 AND BTC RSI4_1h<40 AND BTC RSI2_1h<30 AND pair RSI30m<40 AND RSI1h<40 AND RSI5m<30 AND RSI5m<RSI1h AND volume>0
implementation_notes: Informative pair merge via merge_informative_pair (ffill) - this is the lookahead-safe helper; verify. Needs BTC and ETH/BTC data for same exchange. Demo of informative pairs. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
